review:
Three reels, one line, and banknotes instead of fruit. Each reel shows part of a bill, and completing a note across all three pays its value – the top note pays 1,000x.

After any win you can flip a coin to double it and keep a streak going. Low volatility, a 1,000x cap and 97% RTP. Fast, bright and simple – perfect for a few quick demo spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
